motivation: Selected71 has19 binary DEV errors and1391 joint-field errors despite low training error in the preceding larger-corpus head experiments. Test training-only hidden dropout as a generalization intervention using the same frozen representations. Improvement is uncertain. No result-dependent changes to live65 or queued73.
initialization: Original-v9 normalized GELU128 heads for every configuration, seeded1011. Keep the selected71 policy coefficients0.25RO/1UK fixed across all treatments and the matching zero-dropout control. No initialization from selected71; no encoder or other-language weights change.
treatment: Apply nn.Dropout after hidden GELU and before the last linear layer only while training. No additional trainable tensors, no deployment-architecture change. Disable dropout for every DEV evaluation and for exported reload.
loss: Existing binaryCE + mean class-weighted six-fieldCE +0.2 mean seven-head teacherKL, plus fixed language coefficient times BCE of the existing coupled-policy probability. Clamp probability to[1e-6,1-1e-6] only for BCE. Policy semantics, inference scorer and fixed couplings do not change.
optimizer: Same AdamW learning rate0.0001, decay0.01, gradient clip1.0; batch64,12 epochs per configuration. CPU execution differs from prior62 GPU execution, so dropout-control is rerun on the same backend as the two dropout treatments.
selection: Retain existing DEV-only rule: assess binary, policy and coupled-policy modes and their DEV-only thresholds; choose minimum binary errors then maximum score margin per checkpoint; rank checkpoints by binary errors, joint-field errors, mean field CE, then negative margin, with earliest exact tie retained. Selection spans all three configurations. Record the selected mode; do not attribute an improvement to serving-policy alignment if evidence does not support it.
evaluation: Freeze selection before all exposed original/broad/trajectory/challenge regressions. Zero binary AND joint-field DEV errors are prerequisite for further qualification, and all other zero-error/no-regression requirements remain. A failed DEV gate is REJECT, not a release. ReservedTEST and final human-review stages stay closed until all engineering prerequisites pass.
data_policy: Reuse exactly the62 TRAIN/DEV feature population. No new rows, relabeling, rejected66 or draft69 records. No reservedTEST files or diagnostics enter fitting. No additional encoder inference.
verification: Check the registered source and every feature/source binding. Run the10 initialization/inference, seeded-mask and actual-objective checks; preserve every checkpoint and training counter. Compare all initial DEV logits against cached original-v9 and selected export reload exactly as71. After completion compare all26 zero-dropout control checkpoints against their matched71 policy-quarter RO/policy-one UK checkpoints, then independently recount selectedDEV with the74 threshold/world audit.
control_expected_from_prior: Same numerical objective, batches, initialization, CPU backend and seeds as71 selected policy coefficients. Any control mismatch must be explained and retained; do not assume a benefit from dropout based only on unmatched controls.
resources: CPU only with two requested BLAS/OpenMP threads; small cached-feature heads may run alongside solefullencoder65. Preserve8GiB disk reserve. No result-dependent extensions, restart or heldoutTEST access.
novelty_scope: Dropout is an established regularizer; this is a controlled larger-corpus experiment, not a claim of new ML methodology.
